annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2408 of 13 September 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for lifting tables, earth-moving machinery, cranes and power operated pedestrian doorsets
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2408 of 13 September 2024 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for lifting tables, earth-moving machinery, cranes and power operated pedestrian doorsets
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision amending the list of harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC. It adds revised standards for lifting tables, earth-moving machinery, cranes and power-operated pedestrian doorsets, and defers withdrawal of the superseded versions. Compliance gives a presumption of conformity with essential health and safety requirements. It has no AI-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Compliance confers presumption of conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC essential health and safety requirements
Deletes references to superseded standards, with withdrawal deferred to 16 March 2026
Enters into force on publication in the Official Journal
